claims.text: Stone chambers ring in the infrasound band: Karnak's hypostyle hall at ~1.7/3.4/8.6 Hz, the King's Chamber near 16/30/33 Hz, the King's shafts as pipes at ~1.4–2.9 Hz, the whole hall through its pylon at ~1 Hz.
Radiation out of a 20 cm opening at 30 Hz is ~(ka)² ≈ 0.4 %: nothing leaves the building.
Prevailing north wind on the north face, lee suction on the south: ~80 Pa across 120 m of 20 cm duct gives a ~2.5 m/s draft through the King's Chamber.
Sun on the south casing adds a solar-chimney term (~8 Pa, ~0.8 m/s), reversing at night.
The King's Chamber stays dry due to ventilation.
Queen's Chamber is on the axis over the natural knoll, floor at 21.2 m ≈ H/7 (20.9), shafts sealed at both ends, niche for the statue.
King's Chamber is off-axis ~11 m south, floor at 43.0 m where the horizontal section has exactly half the base area, h = H(1 − 1/√2) = 42.9 m; shafts open to the pole and Orion.
Perimeter/height = 921.2/146.6 = 6.283 = 2π to 0.05 %, from the seked of 5½ palms (rise 14 : run 11).
Sphere of radius H centred at the base centre. The centre (ka's chamber, over the unmoved knoll) has no finite image: it inverts to everything outside.
Khufu's name in red ochre gang marks in the five relieving chambers.
Hetepheres I buried at Giza, not Dahshur, in a hidden shaft sealed with Khufu's name.
Khafre's coffer lid lies unbroken on the floor of his burial chamber.
The coffer in the King's Chamber has a sliding groove on three sides and three pin holes in its rim.
The Big Void above the Grand Gallery is at least 30 m long, reads as air by muon contrast.
